symptom: approved-central-blog workflow could push HEAD directly to main and BG193 dispatched delivery_mode=direct
impact: GitHub-backed production change could bypass BG169 and exact candidate promotion
root_cause: legacy writer delivery path predated BRAIN-DELIVERY-v2
fix: BG193 now dispatches candidate-pr; approved-central-blog is candidate-only, opens a PR, never pushes or merges main directly
prevention: tests/repo-writer-v2-no-direct-main.test.mjs scans workflows for explicit HEAD:main push bypass and asserts candidate-only approved blog delivery
